versions.content:
[SWS_PHM_00231] Switch Global Supervision Status from kEXPIRED to kSTOPPED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kEXPIRED,GlobalSupervi-
sion corresponds to Operating System, Execution Management or State Manage-
ment, the Elementary Supervision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or
Logical Supervision is kEXPIRED and the measured Expired Supervision Time is equal
to or greater than the configured expiredSupervisionTolerance, then the Plat-
form Health Management shall change the Global Supervision Status to
kSTOPPED.
⌋
